source: Community reference material - face-shape categories (perfectcorp.com's face-shape guide) and a curated subset of a facial-description word list (kathysteinemann.com). Not from the AI Video Bootcamp course.
note: Browse-only reference vocabulary, the same role tools/glossary.json plays for cinematography terms - there is no build_face_glossary.py and nothing here feeds compose_persona() or any other builder. persona_bank.json deliberately excludes any face-shape/body-shape/attractiveness control (see its own note, tools/README.md, ui/views/influencer_studio.py's docstring and workflows/build-an-influencer.md) - a face or build is prose in Influencer Studio's free-text Additional Details field, never a structured pick. This file exists to make that free-text field easier to write well: browse it and copy a phrase in, the same way the Videos tab's Glossary is read for context rather than acted on by the app. Curated on purpose - excludes judgmental/demeaning adjectives, animal-based comparisons and simile lists from the source material, keeping only structural and photographic description.

terms.definition: Forehead slightly wider than a softly curved jawline; the face reads longer than it is wide, an egg-shaped proportion.
Width and length are nearly equal, with full cheeks and a softly rounded jawline.
A strong, angular jawline with the forehead, cheekbones and jaw all roughly the same width.
Noticeably longer than it is wide, with a square or straight jawline.
A broad forehead and wide cheekbones narrowing down to a delicate, slender chin.
Cheekbones are the widest and most prominent point, with a narrower forehead and jawline.
The jawline is the widest part of the face, narrowing toward a comparatively narrower forehead.
A jaw with a clear, visible edge rather than a soft transition into the neck.
A gently rounded jaw with no sharp edge or angle.
Cheekbones set noticeably high and prominent on the face.
Cheeks with a gentle, filled-out curve rather than a hollowed or angular line.
Visible, sharply defined planes across the cheeks, jaw and brow.
Delicate, narrow bone structure throughout the face.
Strongly defined, well-proportioned bone structure with clear highlights and shadow along the planes of the face.
A forehead that is wide relative to the rest of the face.
A forehead that is comparatively slim relative to the rest of the face.
A pronounced, well-defined brow ridge.
A small, softly rounded nose.
A nose with a gentle curve or bridge, sloping down from the brow.
Lips with noticeable volume, top and bottom roughly balanced.
Eyes with a tapered, pointed corner at both inner and outer edges.
Eyes set further back beneath the brow bone, with a more pronounced eyelid crease.
Eyes spaced further apart than average relative to the width of the face.
Naturally visible skin pores rather than a smoothed, airbrushed surface - reinforces the app's existing realism-layer language.
Light, scattered freckling across the nose and cheeks.
Subtle, natural creasing around the eyes or mouth, not retouched away.
A slight, realistic imbalance between the two sides of the face rather than perfect mirror symmetry.
Fine, barely-visible facial hair catching the light, especially along the jaw and upper lip.
A realistic light oil sheen on the forehead, nose and cheekbones rather than uniformly matte skin.
